# New Features Guide
This page is a wiki-oriented index for recently added MLang features. It links
each feature to its reference documentation and to an example or focused
regression test that shows the feature in use.

## Language Features

| Feature | What changed | Docs | Examples |
|---|---|---|---|
| Namespace blocks and namespace aliases | Declarations can be grouped under qualified paths, with local aliases for shorter names. | [Language Syntax](Language-Syntax#namespace-blocks) | [`examples/namespace_demo.mla`](https://github.com/mattilaa/mlang/blob/main/examples/namespace_demo.mla) |
| Trait objects with `dyn Trait` | Function boundaries can accept, return, and pass through runtime-dispatched trait objects. | [Language Syntax](Language-Syntax#trait_objects_dyn) | [`examples/dyn_trait_demo/main.mla`](https://github.com/mattilaa/mlang/blob/main/examples/dyn_trait_demo/main.mla), [`examples/dyn_trait_field_demo/main.mla`](https://github.com/mattilaa/mlang/blob/main/examples/dyn_trait_field_demo/main.mla) |
| Type aliases with [`alias`](Language-Syntax) | Global and block-scoped aliases, including generic aliases, are supported. | [Language Syntax](Language-Syntax#type-aliases-alias--use-type) | [`examples/type_alias_demo.mla`](https://github.com/mattilaa/mlang/blob/main/examples/type_alias_demo.mla) |
| Explicit primitive names | Numeric and string types use width-explicit spellings such as [`i32`](Quick-Guide#types), [`f64`](Quick-Guide#types), [`str8`](Quick-Guide#types), and [`str16`](Quick-Guide#types). Legacy `int`, `float`, `double`, [`string`](Quick-Guide#types), and `utf8` spellings are removed. | [Quick Guide](Quick-Guide#common-types), [Language Syntax](Language-Syntax#numeric-primitive-names) | [`examples/std_string_demo.mla`](https://github.com/mattilaa/mlang/blob/main/examples/std_string_demo.mla), [`examples/std_sed_str16_demo.mla`](https://github.com/mattilaa/mlang/blob/main/examples/std_sed_str16_demo.mla) |
| Platform macros and architecture-gated functions | Source can branch on compile-time platform and architecture predicates, and duplicate target-specific functions can be gated by attribute. | [Language Syntax](Language-Syntax#platform-macros), [Language Syntax](Language-Syntax#architecture-gated-functions) | [`examples/platform_inline_asm_demo.mla`](https://github.com/mattilaa/mlang/blob/main/examples/platform_inline_asm_demo.mla), [`examples/inline_asm_x64_demo.mla`](https://github.com/mattilaa/mlang/blob/main/examples/inline_asm_x64_demo.mla), [`examples/inline_asm_aarch64_demo.mla`](https://github.com/mattilaa/mlang/blob/main/examples/inline_asm_aarch64_demo.mla) |
| Conditional source regions | Whole source regions can be filtered before parsing for platform-specific definitions. | [Language Syntax](Language-Syntax#conditional-regions) | [`examples/platform_region_demo.mla`](https://github.com/mattilaa/mlang/blob/main/examples/platform_region_demo.mla) |
| Type-name property | Values expose `.name` for logging their static type name unless a real `name` field exists. | [Language Syntax](Language-Syntax#type-name-property-name) | [`tests/type_name_property_tests.mla`](https://github.com/mattilaa/mlang/blob/main/tests/type_name_property_tests.mla) |
| Typed [`var`](Language-Syntax) without initializer | Mutable typed storage can be zero-initialized, with `{}` as the explicit spelling. | [Language Syntax](Language-Syntax#typed-var-declarations-without-initializers) | [`tests/static_storage_tests.mla`](https://github.com/mattilaa/mlang/blob/main/tests/static_storage_tests.mla) |
| [`cexpr`](Language-Syntax) compile-time evaluation | Compile-time expressions, `cexpr fn`, `cexpr if`, [`cexpr`](Language-Syntax) declarations, and type-based generic dispatch are supported. | [Language Syntax](Language-Syntax#cexpr-compile-time-evaluation) | [`examples/cexpr_twice_demo.mla`](https://github.com/mattilaa/mlang/blob/main/examples/cexpr_twice_demo.mla), [`examples/cexpr_float_demo.mla`](https://github.com/mattilaa/mlang/blob/main/examples/cexpr_float_demo.mla), [`examples/cexpr_decl_demo.mla`](https://github.com/mattilaa/mlang/blob/main/examples/cexpr_decl_demo.mla), [`examples/cexpr_if_demo.mla`](https://github.com/mattilaa/mlang/blob/main/examples/cexpr_if_demo.mla), [`examples/cexpr_generic_type_id_demo.mla`](https://github.com/mattilaa/mlang/blob/main/examples/cexpr_generic_type_id_demo.mla) |
| Plain block [`if`](Language-Syntax) / `else if` | Colon-free block syntax is the preferred form; legacy plain-colon syntax warns. | [Language Syntax](Language-Syntax#if--else-if-syntax) | [`tests/if_let_var_combinations_tests.mla`](https://github.com/mattilaa/mlang/blob/main/tests/if_let_var_combinations_tests.mla) |
| Guarded `if let` / `if var` | Guarded bindings support typed, untyped, and equality initializers. | [Language Syntax](Language-Syntax#guarded-if-forms) | [`tests/if_let_var_combinations_tests.mla`](https://github.com/mattilaa/mlang/blob/main/tests/if_let_var_combinations_tests.mla), [`tests/while_guard_tests.mla`](https://github.com/mattilaa/mlang/blob/main/tests/while_guard_tests.mla) |
| Return type inference | Non-extern functions can omit `-> Type` when returns infer consistently. | [Language Syntax](Language-Syntax#function-return-type-inference) | [`tests/function_return_inference_tests.mla`](https://github.com/mattilaa/mlang/blob/main/tests/function_return_inference_tests.mla) |
| Lambdas and folds | Inline lambdas and list folds are supported for compact functional patterns. | [Language Syntax](Language-Syntax#lambda--fold-expressions) | [`examples/lambda_fold_demo.mla`](https://github.com/mattilaa/mlang/blob/main/examples/lambda_fold_demo.mla), [`examples/lambda_fold_advanced.mla`](https://github.com/mattilaa/mlang/blob/main/examples/lambda_fold_advanced.mla), [`examples/functional_closure_fold_demo.mla`](https://github.com/mattilaa/mlang/blob/main/examples/functional_closure_fold_demo.mla) |

## Containers and Safety

| Feature | What changed | Docs | Examples |
|---|---|---|---|
| Container-to-container `extend` | Mutable lists, maps, and fixed arrays can append compatible containers or literals with `.extend(...)`. | [Language Syntax](Language-Syntax#lambda--fold-expressions), [Stdlib Module API](Stdlib-Module-API#stdvec), [Stdlib Module API](Stdlib-Module-API#stdarray) | [`tests/mla_tests.cpp`](https://github.com/mattilaa/mlang/blob/main/tests/mla_tests.cpp) (`ListExtendsFromList`, `ListExtendsFromArray`, `MapExtendsFromMap`, `FixedArrayExtendsFromVecWithinCapacity`) |
| Nested container transfer | `.extend(...)` handles elements that are themselves lists, maps, or arrays. | [Language Syntax](Language-Syntax#lambda--fold-expressions) | [`tests/mla_tests.cpp`](https://github.com/mattilaa/mlang/blob/main/tests/mla_tests.cpp) (`ListExtendsWithNestedListElements`, `ListExtendsWithNestedMapElements`, `FixedArrayExtendsWithNestedListElements`, `FixedArrayExtendsWithNestedMapElements`) |
| Fixed-capacity `array<T, N>` checks | Literal and fill initialization, `push`, `extend`, indexing, and `fill(value)` are checked against capacity. | [Stdlib Module API](Stdlib-Module-API#stdarray), [Language Syntax](Language-Syntax#lambda--fold-expressions) | [`examples/array_demo.mla`](https://github.com/mattilaa/mlang/blob/main/examples/array_demo.mla), [`tests/mla_tests.cpp`](https://github.com/mattilaa/mlang/blob/main/tests/mla_tests.cpp) (`FixedArrayRejectsProvableExtendOverflowAtCompileTime`, `FixedArrayKeepsRuntimeGuardForUnknownLengthOverflow`) |
| Array/list literal storage safety | Array-fill literals and returned literals now preserve storage correctly across loops, returns, and nested containers. | [Ownership Model Notes](https://github.com/mattilaa/mlang/blob/main/docs/ownership_model.h) | [`tests/mla_tests.cpp`](https://github.com/mattilaa/mlang/blob/main/tests/mla_tests.cpp) (`ArrayFillBackedStorageCanGrow`, `FixedArrayFillSetsAllSlots`) |
| Borrowing and ownership diagnostics | The compiler has stronger checks around moved values, borrowed values, and container-backed storage. | [Ownership Model Notes](https://github.com/mattilaa/mlang/blob/main/docs/ownership_model.h) | [`examples/borrowing_demo.mla`](https://github.com/mattilaa/mlang/blob/main/examples/borrowing_demo.mla), [`examples/borrow_patterns.mla`](https://github.com/mattilaa/mlang/blob/main/examples/borrow_patterns.mla), [`tests/borrow_checker_tests.mla`](https://github.com/mattilaa/mlang/blob/main/tests/borrow_checker_tests.mla) |

## Attributes, Testing, and Derives

| Feature | What changed | Docs | Examples |
|---|---|---|---|
| `#[fixture]` tests | Test methods can share setup/teardown through a fixture impl. | [Language Attributes](Language-Attributes#fixture) | [`examples/test_fixture_example.mla`](https://github.com/mattilaa/mlang/blob/main/examples/test_fixture_example.mla), [`tests/fixture_tests.mla`](https://github.com/mattilaa/mlang/blob/main/tests/fixture_tests.mla) |
| Mock expectations | [`std::testing`](Stdlib-Module-API#stdtesting) supports mock call cardinality and programmed return values. | [Stdlib Module API](Stdlib-Module-API#stdtesting) | [`examples/testing_mock_example.mla`](https://github.com/mattilaa/mlang/blob/main/examples/testing_mock_example.mla), [`examples/expect_call_example.mla`](https://github.com/mattilaa/mlang/blob/main/examples/expect_call_example.mla), [`tests/expect_call_tests.mla`](https://github.com/mattilaa/mlang/blob/main/tests/expect_call_tests.mla) |
| JSON derive | `#[derive(Json)]` can emit and parse JSON for supported structs. | [Language Attributes](Language-Attributes#derivejson), [Stdlib Module API](Stdlib-Module-API#stdjson) | [`examples/std_json_derive_demo.mla`](https://github.com/mattilaa/mlang/blob/main/examples/std_json_derive_demo.mla), [`examples/builder_object_json_demo.mla`](https://github.com/mattilaa/mlang/blob/main/examples/builder_object_json_demo.mla) |
| Builder object syntax | Structured builder clauses can render to JSON using full [`struct`](Quick-Guide#types) clauses or compact `field` declarations. | [Language Syntax](Language-Syntax#builder_syntax) | [`examples/builder_object_json_demo.mla`](https://github.com/mattilaa/mlang/blob/main/examples/builder_object_json_demo.mla), [`examples/builder_object_field_demo.mla`](https://github.com/mattilaa/mlang/blob/main/examples/builder_object_field_demo.mla) |

## Tooling and Package Examples

| Feature | What changed | Docs | Examples |
|---|---|---|---|
| Package manager workflows | `mlang pkg` supports manifests, bins, tasks, dependency fetching, and build configuration. | [Package Manager](Package-Manager) | [`examples/package_manager_multi_bins`](https://github.com/mattilaa/mlang/blob/main/examples/package_manager_multi_bins), [`examples/package_manager_workspace_fetch`](https://github.com/mattilaa/mlang/blob/main/examples/package_manager_workspace_fetch), [`examples/package_manager_task_graph`](https://github.com/mattilaa/mlang/blob/main/examples/package_manager_task_graph) |

| LSP-focused tooling | `mlangd` and `mlangd-mla` have transcript tests for hover, completion, rename, diagnostics, formatting, and definitions. | [`mlangd` manual](https://github.com/mattilaa/mlang/blob/main/docs/man/mlangd.1), [`mlangd-mla` manual](https://github.com/mattilaa/mlang/blob/main/docs/man/mlangd-mla.1) | [`tests/lsp_mlangd-mla_hover_transcript.py`](https://github.com/mattilaa/mlang/blob/main/tests/lsp_mlangd-mla_hover_transcript.py), [`tests/lsp_mlangd-mla_completion_docs_transcript.py`](https://github.com/mattilaa/mlang/blob/main/tests/lsp_mlangd-mla_completion_docs_transcript.py), [`tests/lsp_mlangd-mla_rename_transcript.py`](https://github.com/mattilaa/mlang/blob/main/tests/lsp_mlangd-mla_rename_transcript.py) |
